name: print-social-joyful-praise-church-posts-with-arch-photos-and-brown-circles
title: 'Joyful Praise' church pack with arch-cropped photos, brown circles and line-frame corners
whatItIs: Five white posts with thin line frames with cross-hair corners, brown circles and half-circles, arch and circle-cropped photos of people praying and holding rosaries, serif headlines ('Joyful Praise', 'Sunday Service', 'Prayer Meeting'), brown pill labels, a black circle with a white asterisk, and triple half-circle ornaments.
whatItMeans: Gentle and modern; arches echo church windows while clean framing keeps it contemporary.
techniques: Crop photos in arch shapes as a window reference.
Draw a thin frame with cross-hair corners.
Use repeating half-circles as small ornaments.
Put the welcome in a pill under the title.

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked with a rounded top like a window.
Small corner lines like printer's marks.
